capabilities: share files between vaults over a socket server
exchange encryption keys and save friends to a friendlist
self-host the socket server via a Docker image
extras: README is a stub pointing to external documentation; a default socket server hosted in Germany is provided, and the server can be self-hosted via the author's Docker image.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to share individual files directly from one vault to another.

requires.name: socket server (default hosted one or self-hosted)

summary: Encrypted file-sharing plugin that sends files directly between vaults over a socket server using exchanged friend keys.
